items.source: Simply delegates to doGetConnection(String, String), keeping the given user credentials as-is.
items.translation: 直接委托给doGetConnection(String, String)，保持给定的用户凭据不变。

items.source: If the "username" is empty, this proxy will simply delegate to the standard getConnection() method of the target DataSource. This can be used to keep a UserCredentialsDataSourceAdapter bean definition just for the option of implicitly passing in user credentials if the particular target DataSource requires it.
items.translation: 如果"username"为空，此代理将简单地委派到目标 DataSource 的 standard `getConnection()` 方法。这可用于仅保留一个 UserCredentialsDataSourceAdapter bean 定义，以便在特定目标 DataSource 需要时，隐式传递用户凭据的选项。

items.source: Delegates to doGetConnection(String, String) with the determined credentials as parameters.
items.translation: 委托给带有确定凭据作为参数的doGetConnection(String, String)。

items.source: Can be used to proxy a target JNDI DataSource that does not have user credentials configured. Client code can work with this DataSource as usual, using the standard getConnection() call.
items.translation: 可用于代理未配置用户凭据的目标 JNDI DataSource。客户端代码可按常规方式使用此 DataSource，使用标准的 `getConnection()` 调用。

items.source:
In the following example, client code can simply transparently work with
the preconfigured "myDataSource", implicitly accessing "myTargetDataSource"
with the specified user credentials.
items.translation: 在以下示例中，客户端代码可以简单地透明地使用预配置的"myDataSource"，隐式地以指定的用户凭据访问"myTargetDataSource"。

items.source:
Default is no specific user. Note that an explicitly specified username
will always override any username/password specified at the DataSource level.
items.translation: 默认不指定特定用户。请注意，显式指定的用户名将始终覆盖在 DataSource 级别指定的任何用户名/密码。

items.source:
Default is no specific password. Note that an explicitly specified username
will always override any username/password specified at the DataSource level.
items.translation: 默认不设置特定密码。请注意，显式指定的用户名将始终覆盖在 DataSource 级别指定的任何用户名/密码。

items.source:
This will override any statically specified user credentials,
that is, values of the "username" and "password" bean properties.
items.translation: 这将覆盖任何静态指定的用户凭据，即"username"和"password"bean 属性的值。

items.source: This implementation delegates to the getConnection(username, password) method of the target DataSource, passing in the specified user credentials. If the specified username is empty, it will simply delegate to the standard getConnection() method of the target DataSource.
items.translation: 此实现会委托给目标 DataSource 的 getConnection(username, password) 方法，并传入指定的用户凭据。如果指定的用户名为空，则它将简单地委托给目标 DataSource 的标准 getConnection() 方法。

items.source: Specify a database catalog to be applied to each retrieved Connection.
items.translation: 指定要应用于每个检索到的连接的数据库目录。

items.source: Specify a database schema to be applied to each retrieved Connection.
items.translation: 指定要应用于每个检索到的连接的数据库模式。

items.source:
Remove any user credentials for this proxy from the current thread.
Statically specified user credentials apply again afterwards.
items.translation: 从当前线程中移除此代理的任何用户凭据。之后，静态指定的用户凭据将再次生效。

items.source: username - the username to apply
items.translation: username - 要应用的用户名

items.source: password - the password to apply
items.translation: password - 要应用的密码
